title: Native acceptance and snapshot profiles
summary: Disposable Flutter inventory host with behavior assertions, Patrol and Maestro acceptance flows, plus Swift textual and iOS visual snapshot profiles with explicit native setup.

notes: Flutter/Dart, Android/iOS emulators, Swift and Xcode are unavailable here. No native execution or device result is claimed.

After creating the new fixture, run flutter pub get and flutter test test/inventory_test.dart in that fixture. Patrol additionally requires the documented Android or Xcode host integration and a booted emulator.
Use Patrol package 4.10.0 and patrol_cli 4.8.0 with Flutter 3.32+/Dart 3.8+. Java 17+, Android SDK or macOS/Xcode are separate prerequisites.

The included Swift textual baseline is authored. The iOS visual baseline must be recorded and reviewed on a fixed simulator; missing baselines intentionally fail. Maestro clears only the disposable fixture app state.
